title: Cathedral of Saint Vincent de Paul, Tunis
scope: The standing Cathedral of Saint Vincent de Paul and Saint Olivia, Tunis. The model includes its polychrome façade, triple porch, rose window, paired tower crowns, crossing dome and rear apse.
limitations: The main footprint follows the current mapped perimeter. Tower, roof, dome and side-aisle heights, individual stone ornaments and some façade details are approximate.
The façade includes geometric interpretations of the stained glass and mosaic. The model excludes interiors, adjacent buildings and individual carved figures.
